job.job_description:
We are looking for a skilled AI Engineer to design, develop, and deploy AI/ML solutions that solve real-world business problems. The ideal candidate should have strong programming skills, hands-on experience with machine learning and deep learning, and familiarity with Generative AI and modern AI frameworks.




Key Responsibilities



Design, develop, and deploy AI/ML models for business applications.
Build and optimize machine learning and deep learning algorithms.
Work with Generative AI, LLMs, NLP, and/or Computer Vision solutions.
Develop AI applications using Python and relevant ML/AI frameworks.
Implement RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) pipelines and LLM-based applications.
Work with vector databases and embedding models.
Perform data preprocessing, feature engineering, model training, evaluation, and optimization.
Integrate AI models into existing applications and APIs.
Collaborate with Data Scientists, Software Engineers, and Product teams.
Monitor model performance and improve accuracy, scalability, and reliability.
Stay updated with emerging AI technologies, tools, and research.

Required Skills



Strong proficiency in Python.
Good understanding of Machine Learning and Deep Learning concepts.
Experience with TensorFlow, PyTorch, Scikit-learn, or similar frameworks.
Hands-on experience with LLMs, Generative AI, Prompt Engineering, and RAG.
Knowledge of NLP and/or Computer Vision.
Experience with REST APIs and AI model integration.
Familiarity with SQL and databases.
Knowledge of Git/GitHub and software development practices.
Understanding of cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, or GCP is preferred.
